text:
maria_ops: FYI I'm trying to request +40 A100 quota in us-central1 for the prod-gpu project but GCP put the billing account on hold due to missing business verification. can't provision nodes, pods pending. created ticket #124578912. linking the error: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/12345?pli=1

samir_infra: ugh. what exactly did they ask for? is this KYC / tax docs or just card issue?

maria_ops: billing page says 'Business verification required' and 'Tax form missing'. also a payment method failed earlier this morning. there's an automated message from billing-bot with the failure:

billing-bot: PAYMENT_FAILED: corporate-card ending **4321 expired. Please update at https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/accounts/BA-REDACTED

elaine_finance: on it — I'll check corporate card and re-upload the business verification. which docs do they want? EIN + signed tax form?

maria_ops: the console lists: "Certificate of incorporation" and "W-9 or W-8BEN-E for tax
residency". they also want a contact phone number.

kevin_eng: current impact: cluster-autoscaler is trying to spin A100 nodes, but kube reports `0/6 nodes are available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu`. pods are Pending. we hit the GPU quota request step in the GCP console and it rejects due to account hold. 

samir_infra: can we TEMP work around by creating a new project under the org with a different billing account? downside: network peering and secrets, plus cross-region if we move to europe-west1 (latency + egress). cost estimate would go up ~18% for model inference due to egress.

maria_ops: not ideal for production rollout. we could also use preemptible T4s in us-central1 for now but perf for our logits-heavy pipelines will tank. also need changes to runtime config (batch size, kv cache sizing).

elaine_finance: I can upload the incorporation docs and updated W-8 today. who should I cc on the support ticket?

maria_ops: cc @gcp_support and @samir_infra. include ticket #124578912. mention the prod rollout is blocked and cite SLA with customer X.

gcp_support: Hi @maria_ops — we received ticket #124578912. To complete business verification we need: 1) Certificate of incorporation, 2) Filled W-8BEN-E (signed), 3) Proof of address (utility bill), and 4) active billing method. Once provided we can escalate quota requests to the GPU quota team. ETA after docs: ~24-48 hours.

kevin_eng: ok timeline is messy but workable if finance uploads today. are there any infra-level short-term mitigations? can we re-route only non-latency-critical batch jobs to europe-west1?

samir_infra: yes we can schedule batch-only inference to europe-west1 using a separate k8s cluster and a simple VPN + VPC peering. i'll estimate the config + infra time ~3-4 hours and cost delta. will post numbers in the thread.

elaine_finance: uploading docs now. will confirm here when complete and update the billing card.

maria_ops: thanks! once finance confirms i'll push an urgent follow-up with gcp_support and request priority for the GPU quota escalation. if the 48h SLA holds, we may need the europe plan as fallback.

kevin_eng: quick note for the ticket: include the exact quota numbers requested -> `A100: 40`, `T4: 0`, regional: `us-central1` and include the project id prod-gpu-01.

maria_ops: done. filing the priority request now. cc @elaine_finance @samir_infra :thumbsup:

billing-bot: BILLING_ACCOUNT_UPDATED: Payment method updated by elaine_finance at 2025-06-18T15:07:12Z

gcp_support: Update on #124578912: we've received the documents, business verification in progress. I've flagged the quota request to the GPU quota team and requested expedited review. will update in ~12-24 hours.

kevin_eng: good progress. i'll keep the batch-to-europe plan standing by and will only flip it if we don't hear in 18h.

maria_ops: huge thanks everyone. will post a post-mortem if this causes the rollout to slip, but hopefully finance + support clears it fast.

elaine_finance: confirmed upload and card updated. ping me if they ask for anything else. ty
